stories.headline: Estonia offers support for US Strait of Hormuz mission amid Trump pressure on NATO allies
stories.summary: Estonian Defence Minister Hanno Pevkur and Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna expressed Estonia's readiness to discuss contributing forces to help secure the Strait of Hormuz, while calling for unity among allies. Trump has pressured NATO members to assist but no formal request has been made to Estonia.

stories.headline: Lockheed Martin to establish HIMARS maintenance center in Estonia for Baltic defense cooperation
stories.summary: US defense contractor Lockheed Martin will build a HIMARS sustainment center in Estonia following an agreement with Defence Minister Hanno Pevkur in Washington. The facility will serve all three Baltic states and represents a $10 million investment in regional defense capabilities.

stories.headline: Russian fighter jet violates Estonian airspace, diplomatic protest filed
stories.summary: A Russian SU-30 fighter aircraft spent approximately one minute in Estonian airspace on March 18th, marking the first such violation this year. Estonian Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna summoned the Russian embassy's chargé d'affaires and delivered a formal diplomatic protest note.

stories.headline: Explosion at Russian military base near Estonian border identified as fuel depot
stories.summary: Defence Minister Hanno Pevkur confirmed that Ukrainian forces likely struck a fuel depot at a Russian military facility in Pskov, located 32 kilometers from Estonia. The explosion occurred at what appears to be a fuel storage facility rather than military equipment.

stories.headline: Estonian border guards injured in Mediterranean accident during Frontex operation
stories.summary: Four Estonians and one Greek were injured when an Estonian Border Guard vessel sank during a Frontex operation near Megisti island. Two Estonian border guards are in serious condition and were hospitalized following the Monday afternoon incident.

stories.headline: Russian citizen expelled from Estonia over national security concerns
stories.summary: Kirill Kudriavtsev, a Russian citizen with ties to Russian intelligence services, was expelled from Estonia days after entering the country. The Internal Security Service (KAPO) cited national security threats and issued him a Schengen entry ban.
